question: Should this issue remain the broad memory-management consistency tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 and the Memory MVP issues handle slices, or should maintainers narrow it to one specific config/API contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory config, plugin ownership, doctor migration, docs, and memory lifecycle semantics, which requires product/API ownership rather than a small bug fix.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role slots, backend selection, flush/write behavior, and operator surfaces converge.

options.title: Narrow To Role Slots
options.body: Declare https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 canonical for the plugin-slot slice and keep this issue only for backend/flush consistency.

options.title: Define memory.type First
options.body: Sponsor a smaller config design around builtin-only, qmd-only, and mixed modes, accepting that plugin-role ownership and write lifecycle still need follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role slots, backend selection, flush/write behavior, and operator surfaces converge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product/API direction across config, plugin boundaries, memory lifecycle, and migration, and steipete has recent adjacent config/plugin history.
